style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=11;fontColor=#9aa0b4;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=0;" value="A generic engine, run for the kinds a venue sets to allocated (desks first); hot desks, rooms and everything else stay self-service, sharing the same waitlist. People ask for a kind of space, never a specific one, like booking a hotel room. A weekly run groups the requests and packs the groups onto floors; daily top-up runs place late requests. Every business rule the run applies is configuration: versioned, effective-dated and changed without code, so the plan always records which version produced it." vertex="1"><mxGeometry x="30" y="56" div.div: A generic engine, run for the kinds a venue sets to allocated (desks first); hot desks, rooms and everything else stay self-service, sharing the same waitlist. People ask for a kind of space, never a specific one, like booking a hotel room. A weekly run groups the requests and packs the groups onto floors; daily top-up runs place late requests. Every business rule the run applies is configuration: versioned, effective-dated and changed without code, so the plan always records which version produced it.
